runs.footnote: This result is split across two harness runs on the same 30-ticket sample: the first (run-20260930-134012) judged 20 tickets before a harness fault on the host stopped it, and the second (run-20260930-144322) ran the remaining 10. Every ticket passed verification and audited clean.

runs.notes: Every verification fix in place; 3 errors from a login-expiry bug, 1 no-patch
runs.footnote: Three tickets (13453, 13460, 13465) errored because the sandbox's copy of the login expired mid-solve and could not be renewed; no patch was attempted on them. The bug was fixed in the harness the next day. One ticket (12978) is a deliberate no-patch: the agent found a test asserting the very behaviour the ticket reports and declined to change it. Both count as errors.
